tweets.text:
Over the weekend Tucson Sector assisted local law enforcement with the rescue of two United States Citizen hikers in two separate events.

On 4/5: A Tucson Sector BORSTAR agent working with Pinal Air responded to a call for a hiker with a lower leg injury in the Superstition Mountains. Upon locating the injured hiker, the BORSTAR agent reached the patient by being lowered on a hoist system from the helicopter. After providing initial first aid the rescue team extracted the hiker via a rescue harness.

On 4/6: Sonoita Station agents and CBP Air and Marine Operations assisted Santa Cruz Sheriff’s Office with locating a hiker who had been lost for 2 days. CBP Air and Marine operations located the hiker and within an hour of receiving the call agents on the ground made contact. Agents transported him to EMS waiting nearby. 

@PinalCSO @SCCSheriff 

https://t.co/HDYQIara9P
